decision_context.reason: The 15-item two-model calibration was structurally valid but the null-or-irrelevant envelope was not publishable under K=5 cluster suppression.

claim_boundary.permitted: Two fixed local model paths provide provisional aggregate ranges from one bounded ChildLens pilot for a later simulator-oracle directional prototype.
forbidden: model agreement as ground truth or human validation

sample.additional_participant_rule: Exactly one additional video from each of 15 participant groups absent from the original sample.

selection.release_binding: existing immutable public snapshot observation plus deterministic restricted-manifest digest
strata: duration tertile over the eligible unused pool
selection.algorithm: Within each metadata stratum sort by selection hash. Repeatedly choose the stratum with the fewest already selected additions, breaking stratum ties by SHA256(restricted_release_binding_digest || protocol_id || canonical_stratum), then choose its first hash-ordered candidate whose participant is unused. Stop exactly at 15.
selection.selection_receipt_export: digest plus K=5-safe aggregate counts only

speech_sample.time_grid: integer milliseconds with start ceiling and end floor
speech_sample.window_normalization: sort and coalesce overlap or adjacency
speech_sample.block_placement: Choose one 60000-ms block in unioned official speech time using SHA256(combined_selection_digest || protocol_id || speech-block || media_key), then map it back to physical source intervals.

candidate_windows.placement: Nine equally spaced centers at the odd eighteenth quantiles of the selected 60000-ms union-speech block, mapped to physical source time.
candidate_windows.boundary_rule: Shift, without resizing, any ten-second window that would cross the retained clip boundary.

retained_clip_profile.video: H.264 yuv420p CRF 24, 15 fps, maximum edge 640
retained_clip_profile.physical_span: earliest selected speech segment minus five seconds through latest selected speech segment plus five seconds, clipped to source duration

visual_paths: pinned opaque local Gemma 4 E4B instrument

terminal_rules.combined_calibration_pass: Every unchanged gate passes on the combined 30-item sample and every required envelope is publishable.
terminal_rules.combined_calibration_stop: Any unchanged gate still fails, including K=5 suppression of a required dimension; no third model, further expansion, Qwen-only calibration, or empirical-free fallback is allowed.
terminal_rules.causal_endpoint: Closed until a passing combined-calibration receipt is bound to the already frozen pre-outcome construction and falsification gates.
